added_failures_note: unmeasured as an armed suite pair: the reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite, and its suite fence is recorded as unarmed. The reviewed run's own gate log is gate-final.log, whose first line names revision a02bd49c4 and whose last line reads EXIT=0 with no test failures, so 0 records the absence of an armed pytest pair rather than a measured zero added failures.

assertion_audit.fails_when: Hand measure() a raster of a panel carrying no solved-flux-coloured pixel (a reference-only panel, or a raster at a scale where the 0.7 pt levels vanish): mask.sum() is 0, unmeasured is non-empty and main raises NO SOLVED CONTOUR FOUND at EXIT=1. Independent of the value passed in, because solved_pixels is derived from the image the check is handed.

Point SOLVED_FLUX at a colour no panel is drawn in, or leave it as the literal 0x3366CC while nova/media/ink.py:45 flux_color moves away from #3366cc: the mask empties and the run cannot report legibility from zero measured pixels. Reverting this line to the previous literal is exactly the regression the commit claims to prevent.

Restore the 296afe3b0 receipt (three absolute run-directory pointers) and check() returns three faults, main raises PANEL RECEIPT UNRESOLVABLE at EXIT=1; receipt-negative-control.log:6 records the three named pointers and CHECK=1.
A repository-relative pointer into a directory that is not docs/figures is now refused; no logged run exercises this branch, since reverting the receipt reaches the is_absolute branch first.

figure_review.result: All three committed SVGs are content-identical to 296afe3b0 once matplotlib's regenerated dc:date and p-/m- artist identifiers are normalised (70436, 71902 and 67163 bytes each side; diff empty), so the commit eebac055c carries a metadata-only re-render and no drawing change reaches the reader. Reading frame-146-trip-2-flux-contours.svg:2057 shows the 'solved flux' legend handle still drawn at stroke-width 3 while the nine solved levels on that panel are 0.7-1.21 pt, which is the legend-width defect the previous review round raised and the manifest's rubric.figures claims repaired.

findings.text: recorded_path duplicates nova/database/filepath.py:399 repository_relative, the one owner the repository created for this capability, and is weaker: for a path with no repository ancestor it returns the bare file name where the owner returns an absolute path, and it omits the owner's relativize_worktree_paths step, so a receipt rendered from a worktree that is later reclaimed names nothing. It duplicates rather than extends or wraps the owner, and check_contour_legibility.py already imports nova.media.ink, so the dependency is available.

repository_root is a second, independent copy of the same parent-walk-for-.git in the same two-commit increment, so the repository now holds three implementations of one capability and a fix to one leaves the other two behind.

the bare-name fallback recorded_path documents at render_trip_panels.py:411 produces a pointer this very check refuses as 'outside docs/figures', so the two halves of the fix disagree about the case the fragment at diiid-frame-146-vertical-loss.html:507-514 promises to support.

the new NO SOLVED CONTOUR FOUND guard and the new PUBLISHED_ROOT restriction at check_panel_receipts.py:39 have no negative control - the only logged controls revert to 296afe3b0 and therefore exercise the fused-pixel and is_absolute branches - so the two refusals a02bd49c4 exists to add are correct by reading and unproven by run.

the 'solved flux' legend handle is a single line2d_16 path at stroke-width 3 while the levels it names are drawn at 0.7-1.21 pt on this panel, against the plotting rule that a legend entry be as thick as the line it names; the defect persists from the previous review round and the manifest's rubric.figures claims every sample carries the width of the line it names.
